wood.role: Opaque unmarked material interior; no source chroma, mean lighting, contour, alpha or generated geometry transferred.

iron.role: Opaque unmarked material interior; no source chroma, mean lighting, contour, alpha or generated geometry transferred.

initial_box_note: Initial wood diagnostic box touched a dark boundary/strut. Final narrower/lower interior excludes it; initial box file retained as diagnostic history.
method: Mean RGB to neutral luminance; subtract Gaussian2 broad shading, attenuate15percent, clamp wood+/-3/iron+/-1.5. Fixed material ownership/ink/alpha remain authoritative. No warm generated wood hue, shiny border, flame or second isolation.
